ROUTES (all under /api/super-admin/billing/razorpay, all requireSuperAdmin first, Cache-Control no-store, errors {error, code}). POSTs: runtime nodejs, isSameOrigin right after the guard -> 403 {error:"Forbidden",code:"bad_origin"}, rate limit, [id] isUuid -> 400 bad_request.
List query: mode=all|test|live, status, method, kind (transactions), search (provider id exact or account name), sort, dir=asc|desc, page, pageSize in 10|20|50|100. List response: { items, total, page, pageSize, totalPages }.
- GET subscriptions -> items: AdminSubscriptionRow {id, accountId, accountName, mode, env, status, statusChangedAt, intent, providerSubscriptionId, providerPlanId, providerCustomerId, planName, cycleLabel, durationDays, amountMinor, currency, paymentMethod, methodSummary, startAt, currentStart, currentEnd, chargeAt, endedAt, paidCount, totalCount, authAttempts, cancelAtCycleEnd, cancelRequestedAt, cancelledBy, anomaly, lastError, lastSyncedAt, lastEventAt, createdAt}. status allowlist = 12 billing statuses + live; sorts created_at|charge_at|status_changed_at|amount_minor.
- GET subscriptions/[id] -> { subscription: AdminSubscriptionRow & {paidThrough}, invoices: AdminInvoiceRow[], payments: AdminPaymentRow[], events: AdminBillingEventRow[] {id, eventType, source, note, actorUserId, actorName, planName, cycleLabel, amount, fromStatus, toStatus, endsAt, createdAt}, webhookEvents: AdminWebhookEventRow[] (accountId/accountName/entityIds null here), canAct: boolean, configuredMode: "test"|"live"|null }; 404 not_found.
- POST subscriptions/[id]/sync (no body; sa:billingSync:<uid> 30/10 min) -> { subscription: AdminSubscriptionRow|null, applied: number }; 404 not_found; 409 mode_unavailable | no_provider_id; Razorpay error 502 provider_error.
- POST subscriptions/[id]/cancel body {password, code?, reason, confirm:true} (sa:billingCancel:<uid> 5/15 min, counted before the password check) -> { subscription: AdminSubscriptionRow|null, alreadyCancelled: boolean, synced: boolean }. Errors: 400 confirmation_required "Please confirm that you want to cancel this AutoPay."; 400 reason_required "Type a reason of at least 5 characters." / "Keep the reason to 500 characters or fewer."; 401 invalid_password | two_factor_code_required | invalid_two_factor_code; 404 not_found; 409 mode_unavailable | not_cancellable; 502 provider_error "Razorpay could not complete the request (HTTP <s> <code>: <msg>). Try again in a minute."; 429 rate limited. Order: same-origin, rate limit, body checks, reauth, load row, cancel(pid,false), markCancelRequested(id,"admin"), sync, audit; after() delivers emails (limit 5).
- GET transactions -> items: AdminPaymentRow {id, mode, accountId, accountName, providerPaymentId, providerOrderId, subscriptionId, providerSubscriptionId, kind, status, amountMinor, currency, amountRefundedMinor, refundStatus, captured, method, cardNetwork, cardType, cardLast4, cardIssuer, vpaMasked, bank, wallet, feeMinor, taxMinor, errorCode, errorDescription, errorSource, errorStep, errorReason, providerCreatedAt, capturedAt, failedAt, grantedFrom, grantedUntil, accessAppliedAt, anomaly, createdAt}. status created|authorized|captured|refunded|failed; method card|upi|emandate|nach|netbanking|wallet; kind authorization|charge|upfront|unknown; sorts created_at|amount_minor|captured_at.
- GET invoices -> items: AdminInvoiceRow {id, mode, accountId, accountName, providerInvoiceId, subscriptionId, status, amountMinor, amountPaidMinor, amountDueMinor, grossAmountMinor, taxAmountMinor, currency, billingStart, billingEnd, issuedAt, paidAt, expiredAt, providerPaymentId, shortUrl, createdAt}. sorts created_at|billing_end|amount_minor.
- GET refunds -> items: AdminRefundRow {id, mode, accountId, accountName, providerRefundId, paymentId, providerPaymentId, amountMinor, currency, status, speedRequested, speedProcessed, providerCreatedAt, processedAt, accessEffect, createdAt}. status pending|processed|failed.
- GET disputes -> items: AdminDisputeRow {id, mode, accountId, accountName, providerDisputeId, paymentId, providerPaymentId, amountMinor, currency, reasonCode, phase, status, respondBy, providerCreatedAt, createdAt}. status open|under_review|won|lost|closed; sorts created_at|respond_by.
- GET webhook-events (anomaly=1 filter; search also takes evt_ ids) -> items: AdminWebhookEventRow {id, mode, providerEventId, eventType, accountId, accountName, entityIds, receivedAt, status, attempts, nextAttemptAt, processedAt, lastError, anomaly, requeueCount, requeuedAt, requeuedBy, requeuedByName}.
- POST webhook-events/[id]/retry (no body; sa:billingRetry:<uid> 30/10 min) -> { outcome: "requeued", id }; 404 not_found; 409 mode_unavailable (event mode != server mode, rpc not called); 409 not_retryable "Only failed or dead events can be retried."; after() processDueWebhookEvents(deps, {limit:1, id}).
- GET reconcile -> items: AdminReconciliationRunRow {id, mode, scope, status, checked, changed, errors: string[], startedAt, finishedAt, triggeredBy, triggeredByName}; status running|succeeded|failed. POST reconcile (sa:billingReconcile:<uid> 3/10 min) -> { mode, ms, events, subscriptions, notifications, purged, errors: number } (same as /api/billing/cron), startRun(mode, "admin", <uid>).
- GET overview -> { configured: boolean, mode: "test"|"live"|null, overview: { subscriptions: {"<mode>:<status>": n}, trialing_with_autopay: {mode: n}, upcoming_charges_7d: {mode: n}, failures_7d: {mode: n}, webhooks: {mode: {last_received_at, failed, dead, anomalies}}, last_runs: {mode: {id, scope, status, checked, changed, error_count, started_at, finished_at, triggered_by}} } } (each map defaults to {}).

DEVIATIONS: (1) Admin cancel is always immediate (design decision 2). (2) Cancel and sync answer with a fresh AdminSubscriptionRow read after the action (may be null only if the row vanished). (3) adminBillingErrorResponse shows Razorpay wording and HTTP status (502 provider_error) and database messages (500 internal) to the operator instead of the customer-safe generic text; anything else goes through toRazorpayErrorResponse. (4) Audit writes are best-effort: a failed audit never turns a completed Razorpay cancel into an error (logged). (5) Tests do not cover the sync and retry rate limits (plan only listed cancel and reconcile); their keys and limits were checked by reading the code.
